title: End-to-end pipeline (validate->clean->deidentify->label->export) on a real openly-licensed dataset, reproducible
context: This exercises the full step chain (validate -> clean -> deidentify -> label -> export) on a real openly-licensed dataset, proving the privacy and provenance gates and the byte-identical reproducibility invariant together. It is not yet partner-accepted, so it does not satisfy Definition of Shipped. Output license follows the source. Depends on csp-clean-008, csp-privacy-010, csp-label-012, and csp-adapter-013.
objective: Run the full validate->clean->deidentify->label->export pipeline on a real openly-licensed dataset so it reproduces byte-identically, emits standards-conformant output + complete provenance, and passes the privacy/sensitivity invariant tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs the full step chain on a real openly-licensed dataset and reproduces byte-identically
Output is standards-conformant (DwC/Frictionless), carries a complete provenance manifest, and passes the privacy/sensitivity invariant tests
No PII or finer-than-permitted sensitive coordinates in the output
Marked not yet partner-accepted (does not meet Definition of Shipped); output license follows the source
output: /output/e2e-pipeline-014/ containing the PipelineSpec, the cleaned/validated/de-identified standards-conformant output, the run manifest, and the privacy/provenance gate results.
outputLicense: Follows source dataset license (e.g. CC0/CC-BY/ODbL); recorded per run
